captured_from: SYNTHETIC (not a container capture): a real Redis server always replies `+PONG` to `PING` -- there is no way to elicit a different, still-valid RESP reply from an unmodified Redis container using this probe's fixed request, so a genuinely different reply requires a different, RESP-compatible server (e.g. KeyDB, Dragonfly) this task did not run. This is exactly `-ERR unknown command`, the shape documented in Redis's own RESP protocol specification's "Simple errors" section (a reply beginning `-` and terminated by CRLF), used here to pin the weak-evidence path (redis.protocol.resp_shaped.v1) directly.
